title.value: Prioritizing Samples in Reinforcement Learning with Reducible Loss
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the primary focus of the paper, which is about enhancing reinforcement learning by prioritizing samples based on their learnability, specifically through a concept termed 'Reducible Loss'.
title.quote: In this paper, we propose a method to prioritize samples based on how much we can learn from a sample... We develop an algorithm to prioritize samples with high learn-ability...

extractions.description: This paper introduces a novel method for sample prioritization in reinforcement learning, called Reducible Loss (ReLo). Unlike traditional methods that prioritize based solely on training loss, ReLo prioritizes samples where training loss can be reduced significantly, enhancing robustness and sample efficiency. The method is applied to various reinforcement learning scenarios, demonstrating better performance and lower computational overhead compared to existing methods. The paper provides experimental results on benchmarks like the DeepMind Control Suite and OpenAI Gym.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily focuses on optimizing reinforcement learning through a method called Reducible Loss, which isn't directly related to any eco-responsible AI applications. The main focus is on algorithmic improvements rather than environmental impacts.
